name: gadget
description: Query, debug and (optionally) change data in any Gadget app: records, schema, counts, exports, logs, with optional write/delete tools, PII redaction and an audit log.

app.title: Gadget app slug
app.description: The subdomain of your app, e.g. my-app for my-app.gadget.app

api_key.title: Gadget API key
api_key.description: From <app>.gadget.app/edit/settings/api-keys. Give the key a role with read access (and action permissions if you enable writes).

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Enable create_record, update_record, bulk_update and run_action

write_models.title: Limit writes to models
write_models.description: Optional comma-separated models (or global action names) that writes may touch, e.g. label,blogPost. Leave empty for all.

redact_fields.title: Hide personal data
redact_fields.description: "pii" hides emails, phones, names and addresses from results; or list field patterns like email,*phone*. Leave empty to show everything.
